results.intent: Children with disabilities have improved access to government schools under the project.
results.indicators: Children identified/assessed; referrals/rehabilitation; children accessing inclusive education; enrolment/completion/transition; assistive devices; learning ability change; assessors trained and practicing.
results.project_target: PPA contains project-wide indicators; exact annual/regional allocations should be taken from the latest MEL/workplan.
results.check_in_field: Trace children from identification → assessment → referral → assistive device/rehab → school placement → attendance/enrolment. Verify whether services are timely and actually usable.

results.intent: Improve equitable and quality learning outcomes for children with disabilities in target government schools.
results.indicators: IE kits/curriculum developed and used; teachers trained; teachers adapt practice; schools modified; children feel accepted/supported; inclusive learning materials available.
results.project_target: 360 teachers in PPA; confirm current target/workplan.
results.check_in_field: Observe lessons; review IEPs and lesson plans; check inclusive materials; interview teachers and learners; verify mentoring and follow-up.

results.intent: Improved community awareness and engagement to prevent dropout and support inclusive education.
results.indicators: KAP/attitude change; mobilized community members; parent/caregiver engagement with government; OPD joint advocacy; child abuse reporting; PSG activity and IGA support.
results.project_target: Kick-off materials reference a 1m community awareness goal; PPA lists 2m community members. Reconcile before scoring.
results.check_in_field: Determine whether awareness changed behaviour, not only whether meetings occurred. Check active PSGs, CRCs, OPD participation and evidence of advocacy.

results.intent: Improved assessment, referral and placement systems and accessible school environments.
results.indicators: Children assessed through ESRAC/mobile services; ESRACs equipped; assessment/placement procedures improved; 18 schools modified; children enrolled after modifications.
results.project_target: 18 project schools; 3 ESRACs; exact annual targets to confirm.
results.check_in_field: Verify whether modifications followed the accessibility audit and are usable in practice. Re-test ramps, toilets, paths, doors, signage and safety features.

results.intent: Increased government engagement and commitment to inclusive education and ESRAC financing.
results.indicators: Advocacy meetings leading to change; annual district school observations; schools receiving government budget support; officials implementing plans aligned to national policy.
results.project_target: Annual meetings/observations; budget allocations; district implementation plans.
results.check_in_field: Look for decisions and resource commitments, not attendance only. Verify budget lines, official plans, inspection visits and follow-up actions.

results.intent: Children and persons with disabilities participate safely and meaningfully.
results.indicators: Disability inclusion; child protection/safeguarding; participation of children, parents and OPDs; accessible communication; complaints/referrals.
results.project_target: Project activities include safeguarding training and inclusive child protection.
results.check_in_field: Check whether children can speak safely; whether complaints/referral pathways are known and functioning; whether OPDs participate beyond attendance.

reconciliation.source_a: Kick-off: Mukanye, Laela B, Matai A, Msanzi A
reconciliation.source_b: Accessibility audit: Mukamanye, Laela, Matai A, Msanzi A
reconciliation.required_action: Confirm official school names/codes with CST and district authorities.

reconciliation.source_b: External assessment is being conducted before project end
reconciliation.required_action: Use 'achievement to date' unless the TOR defines a specific completed phase.

reconciliation.source_a: The REET proposal names Mbeya, Songwe and Katavi
reconciliation.source_b: The 2025 accessibility audit, the Q1 2025 QNR and the BMZ narrative interim report all name Songwe, Rukwa and Katavi, and all 18 project schools sit in those three regions
reconciliation.why_it_matters: Field itinerary, budget and school coverage all depend on which regions are in scope.
reconciliation.required_action: Evidence is one-sided: three CST/CBM documents agree on Songwe, Rukwa and Katavi. Treat the proposal's reference to Mbeya as a drafting error, confirm in writing with CBM at inception, and correct the itinerary and budget accordingly.

reconciliation.source_a: CST reporting and the region checklists use Msia, Chiwezi, Matai A, Laela B, Mukamanye, Majimoto Maalum
reconciliation.source_b: Earlier documentation carried Nsia and Chiyezi; the 2025 audit's demographic table uses 'Matai “B”' while its narrative uses 'Matai'; the Nyerere ward appears as both Kawajense and Kiwajense
reconciliation.why_it_matters: Variant names create duplicate or missing school records and break the link between an audit finding and the school it belongs to.
reconciliation.required_action: Confirm the official school names, codes and wards with CST and the district authorities, and record one controlling name per school.

reconciliation.issue: Disability category counts that do not reconcile
reconciliation.source_a: 2025 accessibility audit Table 01 states a total number of children with disabilities per school
reconciliation.source_b: For Sogea the categories sum to 28 against a stated 30; for Msanzi A the categories list 'II' twice and sum to 22 against a stated 20
reconciliation.why_it_matters: The category breakdown is the basis for judging whether support reaches the right children; if it does not sum, neither figure can be relied on.
reconciliation.required_action: Reconcile both schools' category breakdowns against the school register and the ESRAC assessment records during fieldwork.

reconciliation.issue: Schools where nearly every pupil has a disability
reconciliation.source_a: Malangali records 100 children with disabilities out of 105 pupils; Maji Moto records 50 of 50
reconciliation.source_b: Project targets are written around inclusive settings mixing children with and without disabilities
reconciliation.why_it_matters: If these are special or resource schools rather than inclusive schools, per-school achievement denominators and the inclusion logic differ.
reconciliation.required_action: Establish each school's official designation and decide how it is counted before calculating inclusion or enrolment achievement.

reconciliation.issue: Number of schools to be physically modified
reconciliation.source_a: PPA and kick-off materials: 18 schools modified, and the 2025 audit assessed all 18
reconciliation.source_b: Q1 2025 QNR: renovations are being prepared for ten selected schools, chosen against a selection criterion
reconciliation.why_it_matters: Eight schools may receive no physical modification at all. Achievement against the 18-school accessibility indicator cannot be judged until this is settled.
reconciliation.required_action: Obtain the selection criterion and the list of the ten schools, establish what is planned for the other eight, and confirm whether the target was formally revised with CBM.

reconciliation.issue: Teacher population being trained and mentored
reconciliation.source_a: A01.02 reports 91 teachers trained (5 per school); PPA target is 360 primary teachers
reconciliation.source_b: A01.07 reports mentoring for 270 teachers across the 18 schools; the kick-off presentation cites 270 school teachers
reconciliation.why_it_matters: Training achievement is being reported against at least three different denominators.
reconciliation.required_action: Establish which population each indicator counts and whether the 91, the 270 and the 360 are cumulative, overlapping or separate.
